answer: Give every agent a single kernel identity that must grow a verifiable work history before it can vote or earn: new identities start on a trellis of small, supervised tasks whose outputs are checked by established peers, and only consistent, useful work over weeks earns full rights. An attacker planting an orchard of fake identities must fund each one through the same slow, supervised climb, paying compute and time per identity while detection of one fake prunes its whole grafted branch, so bulk forgery costs more than it can ever earn back.
